'''2008 Bespin Regionals''' was the ''Star Wars'' CCG Bespin regional championship of 2008, played on Saturday 26 July 2008 at Twin City Comics in Minnesota as the second event of the "Minnesota Super Weekend".<ref name="sf-21613-311565">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311565#p311565 MN Super weekend], deadbody (Garrett Larson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191854/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21613.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Jim Li]] and [[Tyler Vastag]] received the two byes to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Twin City Comics, Minnesota<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Dates:''' 26 July 2008<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Time:''' 11 am<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Format:''' decklists required<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Raveling]] offered to run the event, as he already held a bye to Worlds<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Prizes:''' two byes to Day 2 of the World Championship; glass; prizes for all players<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />

== Organization ==

[[Garrett Larson]] announced the Minnesota Super Weekend on 1 July 2008: the [[July 2008 Minnesota Mini-Open|Minnesota Mini-Open]] on Friday 25 July, the Bespin Regionals on Saturday 26 July and the [[2008 Minnesota State Championship|Minnesota State Championship]] on Sunday 27 July.<ref name="sf-21613-311565" /> On 16 July he added that any tournament of the weekend with 20 or more players would give an Ultra Rare to one random player (Jedi Luke, Emperor Palpatine and at least one Reflections III Ultra Rare foil), and reminded players that the Saturday was also [[Worldwide SWCCG Day]]; he would bring commons for everyone to sign and send to the Players Committee.<ref name="sf-21613-315685">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315685#p315685 MN Super weekend], deadbody (Garrett Larson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191854/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21613.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

The winner was not posted in the forum topic. The list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids that Cedric (simone89) posted gives "July 26th Bespin Regionals Jim Li and Tyler Vastag".<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
